description: Which Rosary mysteries to pray on a given day (Joyful Monday and Saturday, Sorrowful Tuesday and Friday, Glorious Wednesday and Sunday, Luminous Thursday), with the five mysteries, their fruits and Douay-Rheims scripture, the weekly schedule and a link to the free guided Rosary. Pass a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a weekday; with neither, uses today in US Eastern time. Example: "What are the rosary mysteries today?"

weekday.description: Day of the week, e.g. Wednesday.

name: get_rosary_mysteries

date.description: Date asked about, when one was given or defaulted.

guided_rosary.description: One-line description of the guided Rosary.

guided_rosary_url.description: Link to the free guided Rosary.

mystery_set.description: The set for that day: name, days it is prayed, its page, markdown and pray-now URLs, and the five mysteries with fruit and scripture.

schedule.description: Weekday to mystery set, Monday to Sunday.

title: Today's Rosary mysteries
